# Ways to pay: UPI, cards, net banking, cash on delivery and EMI

## Payment failed but money was taken?

Sometimes a UPI or card payment fails at our end after your bank has taken the money. The bank reverses it automatically, usually within 5–7 business days. If it hasn't come back after 7 business days, email us with the date, the amount and the UPI reference number (UTR) or the last four digits of the card, and we will trace it.

# Ways to pay: UPI, cards, net banking, cash on delivery and EMI

## Charged twice?

If you see two charges for one order, one of them is usually a payment that failed and will be reversed as above. If both stay for more than 7 business days, email us with both references and we will refund the extra one.

# An item is missing from my parcel

## Then, tell us within 48 hours

If it still isn't there, email support@tidewater.example **within 48 hours of delivery** with:

- your order ID (it looks like TW-10423),
- which item is missing, and
- a photo of the parcel and its shipping label.

We check the weight our warehouse recorded when your parcel was packed and what the courier recorded, and reply within one business day.

# Tracking your order

## When to contact us

Please email support@tidewater.example with your order ID if:

- the tracking hasn't changed for 3 business days,
- your order is past its delivery time (3–6 business days for standard, 1–2 for express, 7–14 for international), or
- the tracking says **Delivered** but you don't have the parcel. Check with neighbours and your building's security first; then tell us within 48 hours.

We open a trace with the courier, which usually takes up to 3 business days. If the parcel is lost, we send the items again or refund you in full, including shipping.

# Express delivery

## If express is late

If your express parcel hasn't arrived within 2 business days of leaving our warehouse, email us with your order ID. We will chase the courier and tell you what happened.

# Warranty and how to claim

## How to claim

Email support@tidewater.example with:

1. your **order ID** (it looks like TW-10423; it is in your order confirmation email),
2. **photos** of the fault, close up and of the whole item, and
3. a photo of the product label inside the item.

A claim needs the order ID and photos; without them we can't start it. If you have lost the order ID, tell us the email address you ordered with and roughly when.

# Contact us

## Help us help you faster

- Put your **order ID** in the subject (it looks like TW-10423).
- Write from the email address you ordered with. For your privacy, we can only discuss an order with the email address on it.
- For damage, wrong items and warranty claims, attach photos.
- One email per issue is fine; we will reply to all of them.

# Bulk and corporate orders

## Returns

Unused items without a logo can be returned within 30 days of delivery, like any order. For returns of more than 10 items, please email us first so we can arrange a single pickup.

## How to ask for a quote

Email bulk@tidewater.example with:

- the products and quantities (sizes too, for jackets and sandals),
- the delivery address and the date you need them by, and

On the DryTrek and Roll-Top backpacks, fold the top over at least three times before you clip the buckle. Fewer folds let water in. These backpacks are rated IPX6: they keep out heavy rain and splashes, but they are not made to go under water. For that, use a dry bag inside.

Kitting out a trekking group, a school trip or your team's offsite? We are happy to help with larger orders.

# Your account and password

## Locked out?

After 5 wrong passwords in a row, your account is locked for 15 minutes. Wait, then use **Forgot password**.

# Your account and password

## Forgot your password?

1. On the sign-in page, press **Forgot password**.
2. Enter the email address you signed up with.
3. We email you a link to set a new password. It works for 30 minutes, and only once.

No email? Check your spam folder, and make sure it is the address you signed up with. If you checked out as a guest, you don't have a password: create an account with the same email and your past orders appear in it.

# Your account and password

## Deleting your account

Email support@tidewater.example from the email address on your account and ask us to delete it. We delete it within 30 days and confirm by email. We have to keep order and invoice records for tax reasons even after the account is gone; see [Your data and how long we keep it](privacy).

# Refunds for cash-on-delivery orders

## What we need from you

Reply to the email from our support team with:

- the account holder's name, as the bank has it,
- the account number, and
- the bank's IFSC (the 11-character branch code on your cheque book or banking app, four letters, then a zero, then six letters or digits).

The account should be in the name of the person who placed the order. Please type the details rather than sending a photo of a cheque or passbook.

We will never ask for your card number, PIN, OTP, UPI PIN or net banking password. If someone claiming to be Tidewater asks for any of these, don't reply, and tell us at support@tidewater.example.

# Contact us

## Complaints

If we have got something wrong, tell us. Email support@tidewater.example with "Complaint" in the subject and our support lead will reply personally within 2 business days.

# Gift cards

## Lost the email?

We can resend a gift card to the email address it was originally sent to. Email support@tidewater.example with the buyer's name and order ID. For your safety we can't send the code to a different address.

# Setting up your Tidewater tent

## Something broken?

Poles, seams, zips or buckles that fail during normal setup in the first year are covered by our [warranty](warranty-claims).

# Warranty and how to claim

## What the warranty covers

Faults in how the item was made, such as:

- **seams** that come apart or leak along the stitching,
- **zips** that split, lose teeth or stop closing,
- **buckles** and clips that crack or won't lock,
- tent poles or pole sleeves that fail during normal setup.

# Setting up your Tidewater tent

## Taking it down and storing it

Shake off water, and if you pack it wet, dry it fully at home within 24 hours. A tent stored damp grows mould, and mould is not covered by the warranty. Fold the poles from the middle outwards so the cord inside isn't strained.

# Contact us

## Complaints

If we have got something wrong, tell us. Email support@tidewater.example with "Complaint" in the subject and our support lead will reply personally within 2 business days.

# An item is missing from my parcel

## Then, tell us within 48 hours

If it still isn't there, email support@tidewater.example **within 48 hours of delivery** with:

- your order ID (it looks like TW-10423),
- which item is missing, and
- a photo of the parcel and its shipping label.

We check the weight our warehouse recorded when your parcel was packed and what the courier recorded, and reply within one business day.

# Contact us

## How to reach us

| Way | Where | Best for |
|---|---|---|
| Email | support@tidewater.example | Anything, especially returns, refunds and warranty claims with photos |
| WhatsApp | +91 90000 01234 | Quick questions, cancellations and address changes |
| Bulk orders | bulk@tidewater.example | Quotes for 10 or more of one product |

We don't take phone calls yet. Please don't send order details or bank details through social media messages.

# Damaged or wrong item

Sorry about that. If something arrives damaged, faulty out of the box, or isn't what you ordered, we will put it right.

# Damaged or wrong item

## Tell us within 48 hours

Email support@tidewater.example **within 48 hours of delivery** with:

- your order ID (it looks like TW-10423),
- a photo of the item showing the damage, or of the wrong item with its label, and
- a photo of the outer box if it was damaged too.

Reports after 48 hours are handled as normal returns, so the item then has to be unused, with tags, and within 30 days of delivery (see [Returns](returns-policy)). Faults that appear later on a jacket, backpack or tent may be covered by the [warranty](warranty-claims).

# Jacket size guide

## How each jacket fits

| Jacket | SKU | Fit | Sizes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Coastal Light Shell | JKT-COASTAL | Slim: close to the body for walking and cycling | S, M, L, XL |
| Monsoon Rain Jacket | JKT-MONSOON | Regular: room for a T-shirt and a light fleece | S, M, L, XL |
| Storm Pro Jacket | JKT-STORM | Relaxed: room for a warm layer, longer at the back | M, L, XL |

The size goes at the end of the SKU: a medium Monsoon Rain Jacket is JKT-MONSOON-M.

# Tracking your order

## Your tracking link

When your order ships, we email and text you a tracking link. Guests can also track an order from the **Track an order** page with the order ID (it looks like TW-10423) and the email address used at checkout.

The courier's tracking can take up to 24 hours to show the first scan after we hand the parcel over, so a link that says "no information yet" on the first day is normal.

# Your data and how long we keep it

This page says, in plain words, what we keep about you, why, and for how long.

# Shipping within India

## Prices and times

| Service | Price | Delivery time |
|---|---|---|
| Standard | ₹99, free on orders over ₹2,000 | 3–6 business days |
| Express | ₹249 | 1–2 business days, metro cities only |

Business days are Monday to Saturday, except public holidays. The time is counted from when your order leaves our warehouse, and we pack most orders within 12 hours of you placing them.
